text: Pogačar heads into the high Alps with a stranglehold on GC and the mountains jersey, but Vingegaard has signaled this is his last realistic chance to dent the deficit—expect aggressive early positioning on the HC finale to force UAE into a defensive shell. Evenepoel lurks close enough to profit from any GC fireworks, though his Bora team's internal dynamics may limit how hard they can press. Pedersen's points lead gives Lidl-Trek reason to chase the stage, adding a third tactical force that could disrupt UAE's rhythm before the decisive climbs.
